content: The Eep module shall call the callback function defined in the configuration parameter EepJobErrorNotification when a job has been canceled or aborted with negative result: • Read aborted • Write aborted or failed • Erase aborted or failed 44 of 67 Document ID 21: AUTOSAR_SWS_EEPROMDriver Specification of EEPROM Driver AUTOSAR CP R22-11 • Compare aborted or data blocks are not equal.
